verdict.rationale: Mintlify documents a REST API for triggering deployments, creating preview deployments, embedding the assistant, exporting analytics and managing documentation programmatically. Its admin MCP server also gives AI tools write access to content and dashboard settings. Nothing in the evidence claims or shows full UI-to-API parity, and no public OpenAPI spec was found. Missing for 10: documented API coverage of all UI/dashboard functions (editor review/merge, analytics dashboard, search config, domain setup), an explicit parity statement, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: Use the Mintlify REST API to trigger deployments, embed an AI assistant, export analytics data, and manage documentation programmatically.
Create or update a preview deployment for a specific branch.
Give AI tools like Claude, ChatGPT, and Cursor write access to your Mintlify content and dashboard so they can edit pages, update settings, and open PRs.
